The dt_bias parameter in Mamba layers controls the discretization timestep — it determines how much the continuous-time state-space dynamics are compressed into each discrete token step.

- **Decreasing dt_bias**: Smaller time steps mean more gradual state evolution. Better for fine-grained sequential patterns but may limit how far the state can "see" per token.
